RAJYA SABHA
Tuesday, the 6th December, 2016/15th Agrahayana, 1938 (Saka)
The House met at eleven of the clock,  
MR. CHAIRMAN  in the Chair.  
OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, I have to refer with profound sorrow to the 
passing away of Ms. J. Jayalalitha,  a former Member of this House and Chief 
Minister of Tamil Nadu, on the 5th of December, 2016, at the age of 68 years.
Born in February, 1948, at Mysore City in Karnataka, Ms. Jayalalitha  was 
educated at Bangalore and Chennai. She was honoured by several Universities, 
including the University of Madras.
An accomplished and prolific artiste, Ms. Jayalalitha  contributed immensely to 
the Tamil, Telugu and Kannada film industry.
Ms. J. Jayalalitha  represented the State of Tamil Nadu in this House from 
April, 1984 to January, 1989. She was also a Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative 
Assembly for seven terms. She was the Leader of Opposition in that Assembly twice, 
and six times served as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, till her untimely and sad 
demise. She was an eminent public figure and a charismatic personality.
As Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, her contributions towards the economic 
development of the State and social welfare of the poorer segments will be long 
remembered and cherished. Her death is an irreparable loss to the people of India.
In the passing away of Ms. J. Jayalalitha,  the country has lost a prominent 
leader, a distinguished parliamentarian and an able administrator.
We deeply mourn the passing away of Ms. J. Jayalalitha.
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of 
respect to the memory of the departed.
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute )

2 Obituary [RAJYA SABHA] Reference
